The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors. The change is one condition in `getAllTeams`, in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`:

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

- Unmatched contributors who are dormant (latest commit older than 180 days) are no longer added to the remainder.
- Configured teams are untouched, so their members stay in regardless of activity.
- A blank latest-commit date counts as active. `Contributor.isActive()` already returns true for blank dates through `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so no extra blank check was needed.

I ran `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test`, which compiled the module and passed with no output. There are no landscape-specific tests in the repo, so the behaviour itself is unverified by a test. Nothing was committed.
